subject: cr-info-dy
title: CR.INFO.DY.------C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 52 (WM-28). CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT (social reality) and ASP-ES (aspect essence). From SOC-RT: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). From ASP-ES: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From CULT-INFO-F: INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INTR: MT-INFO (multi-information). From INDIV-DY-RT: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From INDIV-TD: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications).
